title: #014. Party Invitation & Logic Puzzle
subtitle: Model guest invitations, conditional gift budgets, implications, conflicts, and group quotas with tight Big-M bounds.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { invite, giftBudget, totalEnjoyment }.
judge.m3: Guest {p0} giftBudget ({p1}) violates conditional range [{p3}, {p4}] for invite[{p0}] = {p2}.
judge.m5: Implication violated: inviting guest {p0} requires inviting guest {p1}.
judge.m6: Conflict violated: guests {p0} and {p1} cannot both be invited.
judge.m7: Group rule {p0} violated: invited {p1} guest(s), but at least {p2} required.
judge.m8: Reported totalEnjoyment ({p0}) does not match computed enjoyment ({p1}).
judge.m9: Feasible guest list, but totalEnjoyment ({p0}) is below optimal ({p1}).
